item.title: Performance Data Engineer at Urban Grid
item.description:
Headquartered in Houston, Texas, Panthera Grid Partners is a portfolio company of Brookfield, one of the world’s largest owners and operators of renewable power and sustainable solutions.

Panthera Grid Partners delivers reliable, utility-scale solar, wind and energy storage infrastructure to meet America’s growing demand for domestic energy.

With a portfolio exceeding 10 gigawatts, Panthera Grid Partners operates in U.S. power markets where load growth, grid reliability and capital investment are most critical. The company develops, acquires, builds, and operates renewable energy assets with a disciplined, precision-driven focus on execution, performance, and operational integrity.

Through responsible land stewardship and strong local partnerships, Panthera Grid Partners delivers energy projects with respect for land, agriculture, and local priorities, working with landowners and communities to support long-term land value and strengthen regional economies.

Job Summary

The Performance Data Engineer owns the data architecture, pipelines, performance calculation layer, and reporting processes for Panthera Grid’s operating utility-scale solar and battery energy storage portfolio. The role builds and maintains the governed platform used by performance and reliability engineers and serves as the trusted source for reporting delivered to stakeholders at all levels. This position ingests and standardizes SCADA, meteorological, inverter, tracker, revenue meter, and PPA settlement data; implements fleet KPI definitions as versioned and tested code; and delivers fleet-wide reporting through Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Visa sponsorship or transfer visas, including H-1B or L-2, are not available for this position.

item.title: Senior Sales Engineer, Enterprise at Fivetran
item.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About the Role

Fivetran’s mission is to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity — with dbt Labs now part of Fivetran, that mission extends from moving data into the warehouse to transforming and modeling it for trusted, governed analytics.

We’re looking for a Senior Sales Engineer to join our Enterprise sales team. In this role, you’ll work closely with Sales to understand Enterprise customers’ complex data requirements — spanning ingestion, transformation, and data modeling — and demonstrate how the combined Fivetran + dbt platform helps them build reliable, end-to-end data pipelines. You’ll own technical evaluations across the full data lifecycle: from replicating data into the warehouse to transforming it into governed, analytics-ready models with dbt Cloud.

$197,516.46—$246,895.56 USD

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

item.title: Junior Technical (Support) Analyst w. Python (second shift) at Suvoda
item.description:

Technical Analysts are curious, resourceful problem-solvers who love diving into code, troubleshooting complex issues, and taking on technical challenges within a SaaS environment.

This is a remote role across Romania.

Responsibilities

  • Research and resolve issues using critical and logical thinking, ensuring financial data integrity and
  • Write, execute, and validate Python-based scripts for data changes and bulk data corrections in a production environment

item.title: Staff Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) at Huntress
item.description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24⁄7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers’ protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Title: Staff Database Reliability Engineer

Compensation Range: $215,000 to $245,000 base plus bonus and equity

  • One-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office
  • $75 USD/month digital reimbursement

item.title: Software Engineer (Time & Billing) at Litify
item.description:
About Us

At Litify, we’re powering a new era for the legal industry. Since its founding in 2016, Litify has helped law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through its leading AI-native Platform of Action.

Over 55K legal professionals and 450+ enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500 trust Litify to combine cloud-based technology, configurable AI-native workflows, agentic AI, and powerful business analytics into one open ecosystem that moves legal teams from systems of record to systems of action.

Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and recognized as an Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 fastest-growing private company, Litify is at the center of legal innovation. Headquartered in New York, we’re building the last legal platform our customers will ever need.

About the Team Lawyers bill in six-minute increments, and every one of them counts. Litify Time & Billing turns that time into revenue: time entry, billing rules and rates, pre-bills and invoices, payments, e-billing, and a two-way sync with Accounting Seed. If you like problems where a rounding rule matters and an invoice has to be right every time, this is your team.

The estimated base salary for this role is $115-120k. You may also be offered a bonus and benefits.

item.title: Senior Security Engineer – Data Pipeline & Observability - Mid-Atlantic region (Remote) at GuidePoint Security
item.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

GuidePoint is both a Value-Added Reseller (VAR) and a professional services organization, and an award winning Cribl partner (Cribl Americas Solution Provider Partner of the Year, 2026). In this role you will work directly with our vendor partners and account teams, see the same problems across many client environments, and keep up with a market that is changing quickly.

Security data is growing faster than security budgets. Clients come to us because their SIEM bill is out of control, their data is inconsistent, or they are moving platforms and need the data to arrive clean. You will design and build the pipelines that fix those problems, and you will explain the cost and security trade-offs to the people who pay for them

  • Regulated or federal environments (HIPAA, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, CMMC, FIPS); ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance is a plus

    • Note: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role.

  • Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions)
  • Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options)
